review_notes: Current reader resolves scientific_name only, ignoring gis_aliases; adding a synonym only as an alias will not yet translate its label.
Exact generic Fraxinus spp. does not make Fraxinus excelsior an exact entry, though it supplies a possible parent.
MFE dictionary code 243 names Quercus pubescens (Q. humilis); DBF names Quercus humilis (Q. Pubescens). Keep one reviewed taxon with variants, not two invented hosts.
MFE dictionary code 92 spells Robinia pseudacacia, DBF Robinia pseudoacacia; botanical spelling needs review, do not inherit dictionary blindly.
Code 599 Morus nigra appears in DBF but is absent from this dictionary edition.
A vegetation taxon in MFE is not evidence of a mushroom-host association. No species affinities changed.
